mode: fixed development calibration; not E4 confirmation
sample_region: I((-8,0,0,0),(0,0,0,0)); probe at origin; its volume equals Omega4
domain_membership: -t+norm(x)<H; same outer cloud used for all H
operator_denominator: abs(exact Box phi(0)); all four targets nonzero; changed calibration fields do not replace E4 G1

source_reference.method: independent real-space Kirchhoff plus massive Bessel tail
source_reference.extra_queries: 256 evenly indexed archived v0.1 queries; same physical points, no statistical independence claim
source_reference.Fourier_evaluation: exact requested times and grid nodes; no interpolation

statistics: fixed M=16, descriptive sample mean/SD/SEM; no normal-coverage claim, no optional stopping, no power-law inference
separation: B_C-Box=(B_C-mu_H)+(mu_H-mu_64)+(mu_64-Box); last term has quadrature and analytic-tail qualifications
failures: keep every planned run; no redraw, no success-conditioned primary summary; any failure preserves HOLD
overall_scientific_status: HOLD by design: calibration cannot unlock G1/G2/G3
